APP_KEY.description: Laravel encryption key. Auto-generated at deploy.

APP_URL.description: Public URL of the instance. Auto-filled with the Railway domain.

DB_CONNECTION.description: Database driver. SQLite keeps everything in one container.

DB_DATABASE.description: SQLite file path. Must stay on the volume.

APP_DEBUG.description: Debug output. Keep off in production.

APP_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Trust all proxies (Railway is the only proxy). Required for correct URL detection.

APP_TRUSTED_HEADERS.description: Trust Railway's X-Forwarded-* headers for correct HTTPS detection.

MAIL_MAILER.description: Mail transport. log stores mail in deploy logs until SMTP is configured.

PHP_FPM_PM_MAX_CHILDREN.description: PHP-FPM worker cap. 2 fits small plans.
